red: The spirit of McPherson College. Since 1887, the Bulldogs have represented their school with Red serving as the primary color. Red represents the passion, determination, and fight in every Bulldog. Red is more than a color, it represents the entirety of our efforts as a team.
riot: The attitude and approach of the team. Our team is built from the ground up with the goal of competing with schools ten times its size. From the Automotive Restoration Pebble Beach Mercedes to the rapid expansion of the engineering, health studies, and business programs, McPherson College has always punched above its weight. Riot represents our team doing things our own way and going toe to toe with the best.
racing: The ultimate goal of our efforts. Competing in the annual Formula SAE competition is the epitome of this project. Racing describes the shared passion in motorsports amongst our entire group. We aim to push the limits of what is possible and leave it all on the track.
